key_narratives: Company developed software for future distribution and sold developed software
Company listed on First North Stockholm market to secure continued operations
Acquired Spigo ApS through asset acquisition financed by loans and shares
Post-year events include directed new issue of 16M SEK and LOI to acquire ReelNRG for 8.25M SEK
Growth story emphasizing future potential despite current losses
mda_analysis.management_interpretation: Management presents the company as in a growth phase, emphasizing the successful listing, acquisitions, and revenue growth while downplaying the significant increase in losses. They frame the losses as necessary investments for future growth and position the company as having sufficient liquidity through planned financing activities.
operational_highlights: Revenue grew from 75,289 SEK (2020) to 1,926,407 SEK (2021) - 2,456% increase
Employee count: 12 full-time staff at year-end 2021
Listed on First North Stockholm market
Balance sheet grew from 3.0M SEK to 21.4M SEK
concerns_mentioned: Need for continued operations funding despite planned rights issue
15M SEK debt to Råsunda Förvaltning due November 2022
Negative operating results and cash flows
Dependence on planned financing activities to service debt
Option instruments that can dilute shareholders

risks.description: Board acknowledges need for continued operations funding despite planned 13.2M SEK rights issue
15M SEK debt to Råsunda Förvaltning due November 2022, dependent on warrant exercises for repayment
Significant operating losses (-21.4M SEK) and negative cash flows from operations (-17.0M SEK)
Option series TO1 can bring up to 22M SEK in Q3 2022 but dilutes existing shareholders

guidance.commentary: Management is confident that working capital and liquidity will be sufficient due to planned rights issue of 13.2M SEK and expected 22M SEK from option exercises in Q3 2022, which will fund debt repayment and support continued growth.

executive_summary: LL Lucky Games AB, a Swedish gaming software developer, reported FY 2021 with revenue surging 2,456% to 1.9M SEK but net losses deepening to -21.4M SEK from -4.3M SEK. The company executed a strategic pivot including a First North listing, acquisition of Spigo ApS, and secured financing, though remains dependent on future capital raises to service debt and fund operations.
key_highlights: Revenue surged 2,456% from 75K SEK to 1.9M SEK
Net losses widened from -4.3M SEK to -21.4M SEK due to acquisition and expansion investments
Successfully listed on First North Stockholm market
Acquired Spigo ApS through asset acquisition financed by loans and shares
Completed directed new issue of 16M SEK post-year-end
Balance sheet expanded 711% from 3.0M SEK to 21.4M SEK
15M SEK debt due November 2022 dependent on warrant exercises for repayment
